name: METRONIDAZOLE / DIODOHYDROXYQUINOLEINE 400/200MG 30 TABLETS
description: The combination of metronidazole and diiodohydroxyquinoline in 400 mg and 200 mg tablets, respectively, is an antiparasitic medication used for the treatment of amebiasis. Metronidazole acts against amoebas in the tissues and intestines, while diiodohydroxyquinoline acts against amoebas present in the intestines. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
